shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null && git log --oneline | head && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | head -50
cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore && echo ---- && cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls build/esm/components | tr '\n' ' ' && echo && echo ---SELECT && sed -n 1,140p build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts && echo ---SWITCH && cat build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts && echo ---CHECKBOX && cat build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts

echo ---CONTROLPROPS && grep -n -A12 "interface ControlProps" build/esm/components/types.d.ts && echo ---AVATAR && cat build/esm/components/Avatar/types.d.ts && echo ---TEXTINPUT && cat build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts && echo ---FLEX && sed -n 1,80p build/esm/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts && echo ---CARD && cat build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts && echo ---TEXT && sed -n 1,60p build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts && echo ---ICONS && ls ../icons >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "icons installed" || echo "no @gravity-ui/icons"

echo ---AVATAR && ls build/esm/components/Avatar && cat build/esm/components/Avatar/Avatar.d.ts build/esm/components/Avatar/types/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -120 && echo ---TEXTINPUT && cat build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts && echo ---FLEX && sed -n 1,80p build/esm/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts && echo ---CARD && cat build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts && echo ---TEXT && sed -n 1,60p build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts && echo ---BUTTON && sed -n 1,60p build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts

cat build/esm/components/Avatar/AvatarImage/types.d.ts build/esm/components/Avatar/AvatarText/types.d.ts && echo ---SPACE && grep -n "Space\b\|type Space" build/esm/components/layout/types.d.ts | head && echo ---BOX && sed -n 1,40p build/esm/components/layout/Box/Box.d.ts && echo ---TOASTER && grep -n "useToaster\|ToasterComponent\|ToasterProvider" build/esm/components/index.d.ts build/esm/components/Toaster/index.d.ts

python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
p='src/ProfileSettings.tsx'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('''    <Flex as="form" direction="column" gap={6} onSubmit={handleSubmit} noValidate style={{ maxWidth: 760 }}>
''','''    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} noValidate style={{ maxWidth: 760 }}>
      <Flex direction="column" gap={6}>
''')
# close: last "    </Flex>\n  );\n}" -> add </form>
s=s.replace('''      </Flex>
    </Flex>
  );
}
''','''      </Flex>
      </Flex>
    </form>
  );
}
''')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
npx prettier --version >/dev/null 2>&1 && npx prettier --write src/ProfileSettings.tsx >/dev/null; npm run build 2>&1 | tail -15

rm -rf dist && (which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/.bin | grep -i -E "playwright|puppeteer"; npx --no-install playwright --version 2>&1 | head -2) ; git status --short
